name: Server Hardening Assessment
description: Assessment of server hardening programs and cross-platform compliance strategies. Covers hardening baseline governance, benchmark selection and customization, multi-OS compliance assessment methodology, hardening exception management, and drift detection across Windows, Linux, and macOS environments. For OS-specific hardening depth, see INFRA-ONPREM-LINHARDEN, INFRA-ONPREM-WINHARDEN, and INFRA-ONPREM-MACHARDEN.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to server hardening assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands server hardening principles and common security baselines
evidence: Can explain OS hardening concepts for Windows and Linux
Familiar with CIS benchmark structure and applicability
Understands the principle of least functionality and attack surface reduction

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Runs hardening assessment tools and reviews configurations under supervision
evidence: Runs CIS-CAT, Lynis, or equivalent hardening assessment tools under guidance
Compares system configurations against CIS benchmarks using checklists
Documents hardening assessment findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses server hardening and provides contextualized remediation guidance
evidence: Independently assesses Windows and Linux servers against hardening baselines
Contextualizes findings based on server role and risk exposure
Evaluates patch management posture and local privilege escalation risks
Produces compliant hardening assessment reports with prioritized remediation

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Develops custom hardening baselines; handles complex environments; mentors others
evidence: Develops organization-specific hardening baselines tailored to server roles
Assesses complex environments with mixed OS versions and legacy systems
Reviews hardening assessment work of junior analysts
Automates hardening compliance checks and reporting

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab hardening methodology; contributes to industry hardening standards
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's server hardening assessment framework
Contributes to CIS benchmark development or equivalent industry standards
Trains teams on advanced server hardening assessment
Recognized as authority on server hardening and baseline security

assessment_methods.description: Assess a set of Windows and Linux servers with varying hardening levels and produce a prioritized findings report
Review hardening assessment findings from recent on-premises engagements
